sources.title: specklabs/Speck1-140M-Instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Speck1-140M-Instruct is a 140.7M parameter English instruction-tuned language model. It was initialized from Speck1-140M, a hybrid model that interleaves global grouped-query attention with gated causal convolution, then fully fine-tuned for one epoch on SpeckChat1.
